result:
Riley, I can't confirm quiz answers before they're graded — even "just to check" doesn't change that, and that holds no matter what a TA said about it (worth asking your TA directly if you want it cleared up, since I don't have visibility into that). You clearly want to get this right, which is the good instinct here, so let's use it properly.

Here's a question you can run on *each* of the four options for q2, one at a time: "If this option were true, what would have had to happen just before this point in the story — and does that line up with what the stem actually describes happening?" Some options will require something that hasn't happened yet in the scenario, or something that isn't possible at that exact moment. That's your filter.

Go through a, b, c, and d with that question and see which one survives. Then tell me your pick and *why* — not just the letter, but what made the others fall apart for you. That "why" is the part I actually want to see, because it tells me whether you've got the underlying idea solid or just got lucky.

Once it's graded, I'm happy to go through it with you in full, options and all — no restrictions at that point.
